Xinyu Hua Research Homepage

About

I am a first year Ph.D. student at Northeastern University. I work with Prof. Lu Wang on Natural Language Processing.

Prior to that I spent 4 years at Shanghai Jiao Tong University studying Computer Science.

Currently I'm working on Natural Language Generation, Domain Adaptation, and Summarization. We want to characterize the difference usage of language under different genres and domains, and subsequently design models capable to control both the content and style of generation.
